alerts.summary: Requests vulnerable to .netrc credentials leak via malicious URLs
alerts.mechanism: agent/requirements.txt requests==2.32.3 -> requests==2.34.2 (latest; >= 2.33.0 fixes both; supersedes Dependabot PR #851 at 2.33.0)
alerts.reachability: Linux agent image (agent/Dockerfile, CMD agent.app.agent_main) uses agent/core_client.py: requests.Session, explicit timeout, allow_redirects=False, TLS verification on. Legacy agent/app/core_client.py follows redirects but is only reachable via agent/app/main.py, which no entrypoint launches. Not in release-images.
alerts.exploit_prerequisites: A malicious URL whose host matches a .netrc entry on the agent host; agent targets operator-configured Core URLs.
alerts.breaking_change_probability: LOW — no API change used by the agent; requests 2.34.2 requires Python >= 3.10 (image python:3.12-slim) and urllib3 <3, idna <4, charset_normalizer <4, certifi; the shared CI venv already runs it.
alerts.deployment_impact: No repo-managed deploy: agent image is built only by agent/docker-compose.yml. Windows agent (agent/main.py, CI Agent Windows Build) uses stdlib urllib and does not install this file.

alerts.summary: minimatch has potential denial of service via globparts amplification
alerts.mechanism: scoped override "@typescript-eslint/typescript-estree": {"minimatch": "^11.0.8"}; no parent fix exists (typescript-estree 8.72.2 latest still declares minimatch ^10.2.2)
alerts.reachability: ESLint/TypeScript parser glob matching during `next lint` / CI lint and next build lint; not bundled into the application.
alerts.exploit_prerequisites: Attacker-controlled glob pattern in lint configuration (repository-controlled).
alerts.breaking_change_probability: LOW — lockfile delta is two entries; next 15.5.29 / react 19.3.1 unchanged (scratch probe).
alerts.deployment_impact: apps/console/package*.json change triggers the Console Vercel production build on merge.

alerts.summary: markdown-it: Quadratic complexity DoS in smartquotes rule via replaceAt string operations
alerts.reachability: Root devDependency chain of markdownlint-cli only. No CI job, Make target, Dockerfile or Vercel project installs the root manifest; it runs only when a developer invokes node_modules/.bin/markdownlint on repository Markdown/config. Inputs are repository-controlled.
alerts.exploit_prerequisites: Attacker-controlled Markdown, YAML or TOML (or a glob/brace pattern) processed by a developer's local markdownlint run; impact is CPU denial of service of that process (katex: prototype pollution already present in the process).
alerts.breaking_change_probability: LOW — upstream markdownlint-cli 0.50.0 declares the new majors itself; the two scoped overrides were exercised (ignore globs, YAML/TOML/JSONC config, stdin, katex load+render).
alerts.deployment_impact: Root package-lock.json is in apps/console/vercel.json ignoreCommand: merge rebuilds the Console Vercel production project(s) from unchanged apps/console inputs. release-images republishes the root image, which carries package.json/package-lock.json as inert files (COPY .; no npm in the image).
